description: Creates a comment on a change event.

id.description: Unique identifier of the comment. Use as the {id} path parameter to delete the comment via DELETE /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/change_events/{change_event_id}/comments/{id}.

body.description: Free-text content of the comment as entered by its author.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the comment was created, in ISO 8601 format.

attachments.description: Files attached to the comment. Each item describes a viewable Prostore file, including download URLs and file metadata.

creator.description: The user who authored the comment.

id.description: Procore user ID of the comment's author.

name.description: Display name of the comment's author.

login.description: Login email of the comment's author.

initials.description: Author's initials, derived from their name, for avatar fallbacks.

avatar.description: URL of the author's avatar image. Null when the author has no avatar set.

rating.description: Optional numeric rating associated with the comment. Null when no rating was provided.

body.description: Free-text content of the comment to create. Required.

rating.description: Optional numeric rating to associate with the comment. Omit or send null for no rating.

prostore_file_ids.description: IDs of previously uploaded Prostore files to attach to the comment.
